notes: D-130-2 red lines and the tier-2 mesh-polyline ratchet, over tests/corpus/*.stl and tests/gates/build_fixtures/*/*.stl. tier2Ceiling is a NEVER-INCREASE ceiling per fixture: an edge that ships analytic today may not become a mesh polyline tomorrow. A decrease passes and the gate prints the instruction to re-baseline it with a note. expectedRed records, per fixture, the red lines the branch that seeded this file already violates -- an admission, not a waiver: the gate names each one on every run, a fixture that heals prints the instruction to delete its entry, and a violation on a fixture or a line not listed here is a hard FAIL. Widening expectedRed to make a run green is a defect. The causes are attributed in _team/reports/130-bind.md 4: 'unhandled' is ONE cause on every fixture that carries it -- exactMaxAtBind has no ellipse class, so an ellipse edge ships analytic with no closed-form supremum (D-130-2 admits Ellipse in tier 1); 'overTol' is a recorded tolerance below the certified supremum on 13 edges; 'overCap' is the recorded tolerance above meshTolCap, which is the 1.2.0 registered sliver-plate limitation plus the later tolerance writers. None of the three is relaxed by this file.
